Name: Dynamic Rugs and Floors
Author: Pixeltica
Description:
[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/drfv/divider_logo_v1.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to Dynamic Rugs & Floors 2.0! [/b][/center]

There are now nearly 300 vanilla textures - lovingly reworked to create seamless dynamic patterns that adjust based on placed tiles. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. They function the same way as regular vanilla paths and can be removed with a PICKAXE or AXE, or for more convenient experience please use Smart Building (see an animated tutorial on how to use it with paths in the uploaded images).

Textures are divided into two types: RUGS and FLOORS - rugs have distinct borders and dynamically adjusting patterns while floors tile seamlessly just like vanilla ones but allow for creating any custom shapes rather than being limited to vanilla predetermined areas. See the attached images for a visual examples of how they work.

The original idea for this mod was born while I was working on the Cozy Modern Bathroom and was nearing 300+ mini rugs to try and provide a way create any-size bath mats. Safe to say it got way too complicated, and it was not a good user experience.... but [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/rokugin]rokugin[/url] has saved me from giving up on the idea by suggesting using the vanilla paths as a base! The more I explored the idea the more I wanted to use the same mechanism to make any shape or size vanilla rugs and floors! So many time I'd give up on using a particular rug because it just didn't fit the right way the space I wanted to use it - a 2x3 only when a 3x4 would have been perfect!? A massive 4x5 where all I'd love was a 1x5 runner.... Well now we can have them all!

[center]
[img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/drfv/divider_reqs_v1.png[/img][/center]
[b]Mandatory Requirements[/b]: to access and use the rugs(paths) in game you need to install the following mods:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url] - can't have majority of our amazing mods without it so you probably already have it :)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] - the magic that makes the Custom Rugs Shop and the amazing Custom Shop Tabs possible!

And as always, here are some highly recommended additional mods to make your gameplay even smoother (OPTIONAL)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url] - I cannot recommend this enough for the ease of placing and removing the rug tiles! Check the [b][u]media images for two quick GIF tutorial animations[/u][/b] that cover how to PLACE and REMOVE the rug tiles using Smart Building tools.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] - for even easier access to the vastly increased number of options! 

[IMPORTANT FYI] about Happy Home Designer (HHD) - there is a known bug where selecting from search results gives the wrong ite - this affects custom catalogues of paths only as far as I'm aware and is already being looked at by the HHD developer so please do not report this bug (you can see it raised here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675?tab=bugs]Bug[/url]: Receiving Wrong Item in Search Results in Custom Shop.



[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/drfv/divider_content_v1.png[/img][/center]

[b]Content Details:[/b] You can access the rug tiles in two ways:
1. purchase the portable Custom Rug Shop for 10,000g from Pierre (once purchased you can get as many tiles, and as many times as you want, for free!)
2. spawn the tiles using CJB spawner
3. through the Happy Home Designer Architects Catalogue (NOT the Vanilla Catalogue)

[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/drfv/where_to_find_v1.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center]

In version 1.0 there were 115 textures, all meticulously reworked to create seamless dynamic shapes ( an amazing fun but also much more time consuming exercise than I anticipated!)
Unfortunately, due to the way that the game renders T junction paths there may be some patterns that won't look very good in that setup (sorry!)

In version 2.0 there are nearly 300 textures - they are divided into two types: RUGS (with distinct dynamic patterns, borders and shadows) and FLOORS (seamless tiles with no borders meant to allow for custom floor areas being created) - please note that they are still all just paths so can be used indoors and outdoors, BUT you cannot layer them on top of each other.

Texture sources:
>> Vanilla Rugs - apart from few very tiny ones (like the burlap mat, etc) pretty much all rugs have been included
>> Vanilla Floors - mostly the non-wood panel variant so patterns and carpets
>> Town Interiors - and quite a few rugs and patterns from the interiors of Pelican town (erm, some probably from wallpapers - but I really liked them haha!)
